items.q: So he went with a big band called Speed Webb

ctx.x: Where did he go on to from there?

Well, see, he went with Speed Webb in another band, a big band, that was touring. So many bands in them days was touring, you know. So he went with a big band called Speed Webb, which has Ronald Jones in it. And -- but let's see, we went to a place -- I was getting a little ahead of my story -- we went to play a battle of music while he was with the band, with Horace, in Detroit, and we was playing a battle of music with a band called Earl Walton, and they were on one stand and we were on the other, and the first…
